negative_snippets: Just had to book for a night stay during my travel. Location of the property is good and accessible. But the condition of rooms is not very good and not maintained properly. Wifi found not working. Food was pathetic. Staff was good and very polite. But staff can't solve everything on their own. Property own and management has to take initiative to improve the property.

Other than the location
There’s no meaning to stay in this hotel.
By its looks and interior design it was OYO townhouse for sure.
Food is also 2 star better order from outside don’t go for the menu it may look cheaper but not worthy.
Kettles, room sizes, services all not upto the mark.
Don’t go for this hotel for more than 1.5k bucks. Room sizes are very small. Only suite rooms are good but they have kept them for 4K which also doesn’t justify the worth.
